tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Use this when someone needs mobile data for a trip to ONE country or wants a regional pass (Europe, Asia, Balkans, Global…). Returns the GlobalPass travel eSIM plans on sale there: data, validity, final price, networks and a link to buy each plan. Data only: no calls or SMS. For a route through seve

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Use this when one trip visits SEVERAL countries, e.g. "Italy then Greece", "two weeks in Japan and Korea". Compares one GlobalPass regional pass that works in all of them with a separate plan per country, and returns both with prices and links to buy. For a single country call search_plans.

tools.name: check_device
tools.description: Use this before recommending a purchase when it is not certain the traveller's phone takes an eSIM, e.g. "does my iPhone 13 work?", "Galaxy A54 eSIM?". Returns GlobalPass's compatibility note for the model family and the check that settles it on the phone itself (an EID line in the settings).

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Use this to answer questions about buying and using a GlobalPass eSIM in the shop's own words: when the QR code arrives, how to install it, when a plan starts, calls and texts, data running out, payment methods and refunds. Quote these answers rather than general knowledge about eSIMs.
